P R O J E C T S
IMPEDANCE - Nference Labs Private Limited
Developed a next-generation, impedance-based cardiac mapping system (EAM), revolutionizing catheter guidance by
eliminating dependence on proprietary magnetic systems—significantly reducing both cost and system complexity.
System Architecture & Real-Time Data Processing: Designed and implemented a high-performance data acquisition and
processing pipeline with near-zero latency, ensuring seamless real-time communication between hardware and software
while optimizing storage efficiency without impacting runtime.
Machine Learning & Algorithm Optimization: Leveraged advanced machine learning techniques to enhance the accuracy
and efficiency of electro-anatomical maps, refining signal processing methodologies and boosting diagnostic precision.
Performance & Accuracy: Achieved an industry-leading root mean square error (RMSE) of ~2mm compared to traditional
magnetic mapping techniques, validating the system’s reliability for precise cardiac diagnostics.
Innovation & Cost Reduction: Pioneered an alternative to expensive and proprietary magnetic systems, making cardiac
mapping more accessible while maintaining clinical-grade accuracy, positioning the system as a cost-effective solution in
electrophysiology.
This role required deep expertise in real-time signal processing, medical imaging, and machine learning, coupled with strong
problem-solving and system design skills to push the boundaries of cardiac electrophysiology.
SIG-ID - Nference Labs Private Limited
Designed and implemented a deep learning-based system for identifying Pulmonary Vein Potential (PVP) signatures in ECG
signals, addressing the critical challenge of distinguishing between visually similar patterns, such as pacing spikes and other
recurrent but random signals.
Advanced Signal Processing & Pattern Recognition: Developed a robust framework to accurately detect PVP signatures,
overcoming noise and signal overlap that traditionally hinder precise arrhythmia mapping.
Deep Learning Implementation: Leveraged UNET-1D, a specialized deep learning architecture for one-dimensional signal
segmentation, to precisely isolate and classify PVPs from complex ECG waveforms.
High-Accuracy Performance: Achieved an exceptional 98% classification accuracy, significantly enhancing the reliability of
arrhythmia diagnostics and improving outcomes in electrophysiological procedures.
Impact on Electrophysiology: Improved the precision of PVP detection, enabling more effective pulmonary vein isolation
(PVI) procedures—critical in the treatment of atrial fibrillation and other arrhythmias.
This project combined deep learning, biomedical signal processing, and domain-specific expertise to advance the accuracy
and effectiveness of ECG-based arrhythmia diagnostics.
NEUVIZ - Nference Labs Private Limited
Designed and enhanced a post-procedural analysis tool for electro-anatomical mapping, providing physicians with advanced
visualization and data-driven insights to improve follow-up treatment strategies and patient outcomes.
Seamless Data Integration & Visualization: Developed a robust system to load, process, and visualize electro-anatomical
maps from both proprietary and third-party mapping systems, enabling direct side-by-side comparisons for enhanced
procedural assessment.
Advanced Metrics & Clinical Insights: Augmented existing data with additional computed metrics, offering clinicians a
deeper understanding of cardiac geometry, lesion effectiveness, and procedural outcomes beyond the raw mapping data.
Enhanced Decision Support: Enabled physicians to retrospectively analyze historical procedure data, facilitating better-
informed decisions for follow-up treatments and refinement of ablation strategies.
Impact on Electrophysiology Workflow: Improved accessibility and interpretability of electro-anatomical data, reducing
reliance on fragmented or incomplete records and enhancing continuity of care in electrophysiology procedures.
This tool significantly advanced post-procedural evaluation by integrating multi-source data and providing novel insights,
ultimately helping physicians optimize treatment plans for better patient outcomes.
DYNAMIC BENCHMARKING - Statestreet Corporation
Developed a dynamic benchmarking model to enhance the predictive accuracy of fund and securities valuation by analyzing
historical relationships with market indices.
Feature Selection & Model Optimization: Addressed the challenge of selecting the most relevant indices from a dataset of
over 5,000 options by leveraging Lasso regression for feature selection, effectively isolating the top 50 indices with the
highest impact on fund movements.
Predictive Modeling for Fund Valuation: Built and deployed a high-performance predictive model capable of estimating
fund and security values with superior accuracy, significantly improving risk assessment and financial decision-making.
Production Deployment & Business Impact: Successfully deployed the model in a production environment, where it has
outperformed the business benchmark in over 70% of cases, enhancing fund performance predictions and valuation
reliability.
Strategic Financial Insights: Provided asset managers with a data-driven approach to assess fund performance, leading to
more informed investment strategies and risk mitigation.
This solution optimized fund valuation processes, leveraging machine learning to drive better financial insights and improve
decision-making in asset management.
WAREHOUSE PPE DETECTION - Dimaag AI Private Limited
Developed an AI-driven PPE Detection system for a Japanese manufacturing client, enhancing workplace safety by ensuring
compliance with protective equipment requirements through real-time CCTV monitoring.
Computer Vision for Workplace Safety: Designed and implemented a robust object detection model to identify essential
personal protective equipment (PPE)—including vests, goggles, gloves, and hard hats—using warehouse surveillance
footage.
Optimized Deep Learning Model: Leveraged Tiny YOLOv4, a lightweight yet high-performance object detection model, to
achieve efficient real-time inference with an average per-class accuracy of 95% on client-specific data.
Scalable & Reusable AI Components: Developed modular, reusable components to streamline the training and
deployment of custom object detection models, enabling rapid adaptation to new PPE requirements with minimal
manual intervention.
Impact on Workplace Safety & Compliance: Provided a scalable, AI-powered solution that improved monitoring efficiency,
reduced compliance violations, and ensured a safer working environment for warehouse employees.

P R O J E C T S
BALL GRID ARRAY - Dimaag AI Private Limited
Developed an advanced BGA Transfer system for a leading chip fabrication client, ensuring precise and reliable solder ball
transfers while maintaining critical semiconductor manufacturing parameters.
High-Precision Image Processing: Designed and implemented a robust solution to analyze high-resolution 3D ball grid
array (BGA) images, leveraging traditional image processing techniques to accurately detect, segment, and track individual
solder balls.
Advanced Image Blending for Seamless Integration: Applied Poisson Blending, a sophisticated image fusion technique, to
seamlessly integrate transferred solder balls into the target grid, preserving both structural integrity and electrical
properties.
End-to-End Solution Architecture & Implementation: Led the entire solution design, collaborating closely with the client to
define requirements, validate outputs, and ensure compliance with stringent semiconductor industry standards.
Independently implemented and optimized the solution for accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
Impact on Semiconductor Manufacturing: Delivered a high-precision system that ensured minimal deviation in key
parameters—including noise profile, brightness, volume, and size—significantly enhancing chip fabrication quality and
consistency.
This project showcased expertise in image processing, computer vision, and semiconductor manufacturing, delivering a
cutting-edge solution that met the industry's rigorous precision standards.
COGNITIVE IMAGE PROCESSING/DEEP EXTRACTION FRAMEWORK FOR TEXT(CIP/DEFT) and XAI - Wipro Limited
Designed and developed an intelligent invoice processing pipeline and contributed to Wipro’s proprietary Explainable AI (XAI)
solution, enhancing automation and interpretability in AI-driven decision-making.
Automated Invoice Processing: Built an advanced pipeline to extract key financial entities—including Total Amount, GST,
Vendor ID, Date, and Address—from both image-based and text-based PDFs.
OCR & NER Implementation: Integrated preprocessing techniques, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and a Named
Entity Recognition (NER) model, achieving 85–90% OCR accuracy and 95% NER accuracy for precise data extraction.
Contribution to Explainable AI (XAI): Played a key role in Wipro’s E.T.H.I.C.A (Explainable AI) initiative by designing the
supporting database architecture and defining key metrics to evaluate Explainability, Transparency, Human-Centric
Design, Interpretability, Common Sense, and Auditability.
Business Impact: Enhanced financial document automation, reducing manual effort in invoice processing while ensuring
compliance and auditability through explainable AI frameworks.
This work demonstrated expertise in NLP, OCR, and explainable AI, driving automation and transparency in enterprise AI
solutions.
MATERIALL - RECOMMENDATION ENGINE - AmberTag Analytics Private Limited
Developed a scalable recommendation system for Materiall, a fashion e-commerce client, by integrating deep learning and
data engineering techniques to enhance product discovery and personalization.
Project Scope & Challenges:
The project aimed to streamline product recommendations by leveraging multiple data sources, ensuring a structured and
consistent dataset for model training. The primary challenges included:
1.Populating Product Feeds: Many items lacked recommendations due to incomplete metadata. To address this, an image
classification pipeline was developed to automatically categorize and label products.
2.Fetching Similar Products: Extracted visual attributes from images using deep learning models to recommend visually
similar products, enhancing customer engagement and personalization.
Deep Learning Model Development & Implementation
Designed and trained four deep learning models for attribute extraction and image classification, achieving 85–90% test
accuracy across different fashion attributes.
Optimized model architectures for efficiency, ensuring real-time performance in a production environment.
Integrated structured and unstructured data sources (images, metadata, and customer interactions) to refine
recommendations.
Deployment & Business Impact
Built a minimalistic CLI-based recommendation system, enabling quick retrieval of similar products and category-based
suggestions.
Successfully delivered one of AmberTAG’s first major deep learning client projects, setting a foundation for future AI-driven
initiatives in fashion e-commerce.
Improved recommendation accuracy, leading to better product visibility and enhanced customer experience, ultimately
driving higher engagement and potential sales growth.
